# old-invocation-allowlist.txt — files that may still name the old build invocation (spec 0250
# R31, delta-01). scripts/tests/build-components-references.test.ts fails on any other tracked
# or untracked text file that names it as an instruction.
#
# Format: one repo-relative path per line; an entry ending in `/` covers every file below that
# directory. Every entry carries a reason as the `#` comment line directly above it. An entry
# that no longer matches a file with a hit, or that appears twice, fails the suite.

# Spec text and delta-specs record the invocation as it was specified; merged specs are history.
specs/

# Spec 0255 R5/R6 (row F2): a comment of the overlay twin still names the retired shim it was ported from.
scripts/lib/component-overlay.ts

# A recorded Copilot CLI integration-test log: it documents the commands as they were run and
# is history, not an instruction.
tests/copilot-cli-integration.md
